turns.query: I need in vitro to in vivo extrapolation (IVIVE) for hepatic clearance for 4 BCR-ABL1 TKIs. I want predicted CLh (hepatic clearance mL/min/kg) and extraction ratio for each compound.
turns.responseText:
IVIVE Hepatic Clearance — Scales in vitro microsomal CLint to predicted human hepatic clearance (CLh) and extraction ratio for 4 BCR-ABL1 TKIs using well-stirred and parallel-tube models.

Input: Compound data CSV with columns: compound_id, CLint_uL_per_min_mg, molecular_weight — populate with your 4 BCR-ABL1 TKIs (e.g., Imatinib, Dasatinib, Nilotinib, Ponatinib)
Key steps:

CLint scaling → microsomal protein scaling factors (MPPGL) applied per compound
Well-stirred + parallel-tube models → predicted CLh (mL/min/kg) per compound
Hepatic blood flow normalization → extraction ratio (ER) calculated per compound


Expected output: ivive_results.csv (CLh mL/min/kg + ER per compound) + clearance_summary.json (model comparison, high/low extraction classification)

Decision gate: Extraction ratio ER > 0.7 = high-extraction compound (flow-limited, formulation-sensitive); ER < 0.3 = low-extraction (enzyme-limited, DDI-prone via CYP inhibition) — flags critical PK liability differences across your TKI series.
